The '''Protobranch system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Protobranch/Legends|Protobranch]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Bivall/Legends|Bivall]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SWFF7" />
